Encrypted backups of your imported reports are saved in a folder you choose, for example in Google Drive. Only this app can read them, with your passphrase or recovery code.
This folder is only on this phone. If the phone is lost or reset, the backups are lost too. A folder in Google Drive or another cloud app is safer.
Backup folder saved. Set up backup encryption above to enable import.
Reports are processed on this device. Account identifiers are masked.

Prices for US listings come from Finnhub, using your own free personal API key. The key is stored encrypted on this phone and sent only to Finnhub, together with ticker symbols. Without a key, prices come from Yahoo Finance\'s public pages: no key is needed, but that source is unofficial and may be delayed, limited or stop working at any time. Only ticker symbols are sent there.
How to get a free key
1. Tap Get key from Finnhub. Finnhub opens in a browser tab; create a free account or sign in. This app never sees your Finnhub password.
2. On Finnhub, copy your API key.
3. Come back to this app: it offers to use the key you copied. You can also paste it below. The key is checked with one test request.
Use the Finnhub key you just copied (%1$s)?
No browser found. Open %1$s on another device.
Key works. Prices will refresh on the Portfolio page.
Finnhub rejected this key. Check that you copied the whole key and try again.
Key saved, but it could not be checked right now (offline or busy). It will be used on the next refresh.
